text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- No agreement on Bosnia's Council of ministers was reached in Paris, with Bosnian delegation being unhappy with U.S. envoy John Kornblum's proposal, Prime Minister Hasan Muratovic said.
- Bosnian federation government prepared a set of privatisation laws to be endorced at next parliament session in two weeks.

- Bosnia's electric engineering company Energoinvest signs two contract with Germany's Siemens on Thursday, one on joint enteprise in telecommunications and the other on telephone switchboard installation in central Bosnian town of Travnik. --Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
